1.why: I dislike math and find myself avoiding it, but I can sometimes do basic tasks without feeling like a complete failure.

2.why: It is hard for me to say if I am good at math because I struggle with the subjects that involve numbers and logic.

3.why: I can learn in some areas but often find mathematics courses challenging due to my dislike of the subject matter.

4.why: I do not believe I will excel in future math classes since I prefer art and history over technical subjects like biology.

5.why: Understanding content is difficult for me because I have low tolerance for math and science compared to social studies topics.

6.why: Getting an A depends on the course but I generally avoid math courses due to my anxiety about numerical subjects.

7.why: I would not describe myself as someone who can easily do mathematics since I prefer creative subjects over hard sciences.

8.why: I worry a lot about tests because I have high neuroticism and find math stressful compared to my favorite subjects.

9.why: Preparing for tests makes me nervous but not as much as biology or math which are not among my preferred topics.

10.why: Taking a test is very tense for me because I dislike math and have high anxiety about performance in that area.

11.why: I worry about grades sometimes but mostly I avoid math courses so getting an A feels impossible to me right now.

12.why: Getting good grades is stressful because I do not like mathematics and prefer history art or other humanities subjects.

13.why: I am not confident in tests because I struggle with the type of thinking required for math not biology or science.

14.why: Doing well on tests is hard for me since math is one of the subjects I dislike and find anxiety-inducing.

15.why: Homework feels stressful because I avoid math which is one of my least favorite subjects compared to art or history.

18.why: Worrying about future career use of math is stressful but I hope to avoid math-heavy roles in my job.

20.why: Learning well in a course is possible but I struggle with math specifically which I do not enjoy as much as art.
